en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Zurara, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Allahazwj Fends off the destruction from the whole town due to the (existence of just) one Momin’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan al-Taymi from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Zurara from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Allah wards off destruction from a whole town just because of the existence of one believer in it.”
